each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import itertools

 'center==left': lambda r,c,g: g[r][c]==g[r][c-1] if c else False,
 'center==right': lambda r,c,g: g[r][c]==g[r][c+1] if c<W-1 else False,
 'center==up': lambda r,c,g: g[r][c]==g[r-1][c] if r else False,
 'center==down': lambda r,c,g: g[r][c]==g[r+1][c] if r<H-1 else False,
 'left==right': lambda r,c,g: g[r][c-1]==g[r][c+1] if 0<c<W-1 else False,
 'up==down': lambda r,c,g: g[r-1][c]==g[r+1][c] if 0<r<H-1 else False,
 'sum row even': lambda r,c,g: (g[r][c-1]+g[r][c]+g[r][c+1])%2==0 if 0<c<W-1 else False,
 'col xor': lambda r,c,g: g[r-1][c]!=g[r+1][c] if 0<r<H-1 else False,
}
for name,p in preds.items():
    ok=True
    miss=[]
    for r in range(1,H-1):

            pval=p(r,c,G4i); exp=G4i[r][c]!=G4o[r][c]
